scope: Matched direct controls, FRP, Tailscale private mesh and public Funnel on one fresh CX23 nbg1 pair; previous Cloudflare batch is separate.
visitor: relay VPS for all timed workloads, including recovery; management SSH uses the ordinary public network, not Tailscale or FRP

cpu_models: Intel Xeon Processor (Skylake, IBRS, no TSX)

tailscale.funnel_port_10000: echo except during SSH transfer phases; switched to the same managed SSH backend then restored
tailscale.private_ssh: Tailscale Serve TCP proxy on 2222 to the same loopback managed SSH daemon
tailscale.funnel_tls_adapters: Three verified-TLS socat listeners on visitor; plain TCP/SSH clients are not native Funnel public clients
tailscale.funnel_permission: Only temporary origin IPv4 nodeAttrs grant; no broad member permission

route_observation_summary.interpretation: CurAddr presence is a sampled direct endpoint observation, not packet capture. An idle peer may have no CurAddr. Preferred DERP does not establish relayed traffic. No forced DERP or Peer Relay workload was run.

method.retransmits_scope: iperf TCP sender, not outer transport

method.echo_connection: one persistent connection per path, no reconnects
method.echo_timing: sendall through exact integrity-checked reply; excludes setup, checkpoint and sleep
method.tls_seconds: time_appconnect minus time_connect, not cumulative TLS completion time

method.rate: curl transfer bytes * 8 / curl time_total / 1000000; verified rate requires success

method.order: repetition, path; upload then download within bulk-check
method.verification: bulk-check SHA-256 and exact byte count
method.funnel_precondition: parent switches its echo TLS publication to managed SSH before this mode and restores it afterward

method.cpu_counter: process utime plus stime, excluding child CPU
method.memory_metric: summed process RSS; not PSS; shared pages may be counted more than once
included: both restricted relay sshd privilege roles
method.new_process_accounting: count lifetime ticks only for births since previous snapshot; otherwise baseline
method.unit_move_accounting: rebaseline CPU rather than misattribute lifetime or interval CPU
sampling_limitations: processes born and exited between scans can be missed

method.vm_steal_percent_basis: steal tick delta divided by total VM CPU tick delta
method.zero_cpu_meaning: no observed accounted tick delta, not no operating-system work

resource_accounting.idle: after all application transfers, not cold startup
resource_accounting.frp: all frp-tunnel service processes plus both restricted relay transport sshd roles
resource_accounting.public_funnel: origin tailscaled, visitor three verified-TLS socat adapter services and children; visitor tailscaled excluded because it is not part of the public path
resource_accounting.shared_daemon: same origin tailscaled for private mesh and Funnel; Funnel windows follow mesh windows and retain warm allocations
resource_accounting.sampling_warnings: Four origin samples, one each in frp_upload, frp_download, tailscale_upload and funnel_download, recorded process_disappeared_during_scan. The scan cannot establish whether the vanished process belonged to an included scope; potential undercount remains. No sample or window was dropped.
resource_accounting.not_efficiency_comparison: one saturating stream per window, not matched achieved throughput; remote public relay CPU and kernel work outside counted processes excluded
